gpo_path: Computer Configuration\Security Settings\Advanced Audit Policy Configuration\Object Access\Audit Removable Storage
steps: Sign in to the domain controller as a domain administrator. In Server Manager, go to Tools > Group Policy Management. In the console tree, right-click the relevant GPO and click Edit. Navigate to Computer Configuration > Security Settings > Advanced Audit Policy Configuration > Object Access > Audit Removable Storage. Check 'Configure the following audit events', check Success (and Failure if desired), click OK. If Failure was selected, also double-click Audit Handle Manipulation, check 'Configure the following audit events', and select Failure. Click OK and close the Group Policy Management Editor.

gpo_path: Printer Properties > Security tab > Advanced > Auditing tab (per-printer object ACL auditing) + Microsoft-Windows-PrinterService/Operational log
steps: For print job names in the log, download and install KB2919355. Per-printer object auditing: open Printer Properties > Security tab > Advanced > Auditing tab > Add > select Principal > select Group > select Type and permissions > OK. Enable the log channel: Event Viewer > Applications and Services Logs > Microsoft > Windows > PrintService > Operational > right-click > Enable Log.

gpo_path: Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Local Policies > Security Options > Network security: Restrict NTLM (audit/block settings)
steps: See vendor references for enabling NTLM auditing events (event IDs 8001-8004, 4776) via the 'Network security: Restrict NTLM' group policy settings.

gpo_path: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetLogon\Parameters (DBFlag, MaximumLogFileSize) - not a Windows Event Log, writes to %windir%\debug\netlogon.log
steps: Enable: open an administrative Command Prompt. Set the debug mask: 'Nltest /DBFlag:2080FFFF' (or 'reg add "\\$computerName\HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetLogon\Parameters" /v DBFlag /t REG_DWORD /d 0x2080ffdf /f'). Optionally set max log size: 'reg add "...\Parameters" /v MaximumLogFileSize /t REG_DWORD /d 100000000 /f'. Restart the service: 'net stop netlogon' then 'net start netlogon' (or 'sc.exe \\$computerName stop/start netlogon'). Disable: 'Nltest /DBFlag:0x0' (restart not usually required to stop new logging).

gpo_path: Event Viewer \ Applications and Services Logs \ Microsoft \ Windows \ WebAuthN \ Operational (disabled by default, per-machine, not a GPO audit policy)
steps: GUI: launch eventvwr.exe, expand Applications and Services Logs > Microsoft > Windows > WebAuthN, right-click Operational > Enable Log. Command line: 'wevtutil sl Microsoft-Windows-WebAuthN/Operational /e:true'. Useful for troubleshooting Windows Hello for Business and FIDO2/CTAP security key registration (MakeCredential) and sign-in (GetAssertion), including USB and NFC transport-level detail.
